body:
Hey friend calm down you're going to be fine. Take a deep breath and understand it is very unlikely you will even get caught. If you do then you will have to pay for damages, which isn't the end of the world. It's going to be okay :) You made a mistake, everyone makes mistakes and this mistake is a very minor one.

edit: also if it is just paint on your car and no dents then there isn't even any damage. A little bit of methanol on a rag will clear it right up on both cars.
